text:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing user sessions swap between baseline and canary mid-request. spikes in canary telemetry starting ~10:24. Same user id ends up in both buckets within minutes.
jon: :eyes: any idea what changed in the rollout? can you paste the rollout id?
maria: rollout_id=rl_2026_03_20_10_22. deploy-bot shows an update around that time. Logs show quick alternation for the same cookie.
deploy-bot: deploy rl_2026_03_20_10_22 applied by kayla — changes: rollout_salt updated from "v2" -> "v3"; no config schema changes. Build: cb4a7f
lee: if salt changed, and sticky assignment uses hash(salt + user_id) to choose bucket, why would old sessions flip? cookie should store assigned bucket.
maria: that's the thing — cookie present is bucket=baseline, but next request we compute hash(salt+uid) and we end up routing to canary. Sticky should honor cookie unless bucket no longer exists.
kayla: checking console: rollout config had "sticky_mode": "recompute_on_config_change": true. I must've toggled that while patching. I didn't realize it would force recompute for active sessions.
jon: ah — recompute_on_config_change set to true will ignore stored cookie and recompute using new salt. That would explain flips. But why are some sessions still honoring cookie and some recomputing? should be consistent.
lee: maybe we have a race: edge cache layer (fastpath) uses old cached routing decision for N seconds, origin recompute for others. If salt change isn't atomic across region nodes, some nodes recompute and others keep old cookie logic. leads to split exposure.
maria: sample request trace:
```
Request: uid=8472, Cookie: redwood_bucket=baseline
NodeA: compute hash(v3+8472) -> 0.71 -> canary
NodeB: cached routing decision -> baseline
```
kayla: that matches: my rollout patch was rolled region-by-region, and the salt update landed before the sticky migration flag in the console propagated.
jon: plan: 1) pause the rollout (rollout->pause), 2) revert salt to v2, 3) audit sticky_mode default and remove recompute_on_config_change for minor patches
lee: also add a migration window where we set a sticky-migration header to coordinate nodes when salt changes, and add an invariant check in console that prevents salt changes while sticky_recompute=true
maria: doing pause now.
deploy-bot: action=rollback_checklist start for rl_2026_03_20_10_22 by maria
kayla: i'll open a quick patch to make recompute_on_config_change default false and write a migration note in the rollout docs.
jon: also add telemetry metric: "sticky_recompute_events" with uid sampling so we can quantify exposure.
maria: thanks team. leaving traces and sample uids in #incidents if anyone needs them. :thumbsup:
